title: Your First Day Boss Fight
insight: Awkward moments are just power-ups in disguise.
caption: Leo handles first-day panic by turning every awkward wave into a total power move.

shots.scene: Leo pacing the hallway holding a coffee mug, facing forward with wide worried eyes. Mia stands next to him in her teal sweater.

lines.text: I said it with full eye contact, Mia!

shots.scene: Mia typing on her phone while looking up with a subtle closed-mouth smirk. Leo stands behind her looking sheepish in his hoodie.

lines.text: You waved at a guy waving behind you!

shots.scene: Leo holding a pillow like a shield, facing camera dramatically with raised eyebrows. Mia watches him from the side.

lines.text: So I kept spinning my arm like a windmill!

shots.scene: Mia near a digital clock showing a time, smiling with closed lips. Leo sits nearby pulling a blanket tight.

lines.text: Scoreboard says fifty-six for me, windmill boy.

shots.scene: Leo typing on a laptop with a hopeful closed-mouth expression. Mia stands behind him holding a cup of tea. In the background, clearly visible and drawn in the same style, stands a grumpy neighbour in a bathrobe (the person being talked about), smaller than Leo and Mia and at the edge of the frame, never blocking their faces.

lines.text: Next time: finding a flat with zero neighbours.

shots.scene: Mia holding a cup of tea with raised eyebrows as a notification message arrives on the desk screen beside them. In the background, clearly visible and drawn in the same style, stands a proud dad in a polo shirt (the person being talked about), smaller than Leo and Mia and at the edge of the frame, never blocking their faces.

lines.text: Wait, did you really call Greg Dad?

judge.why: Candidate 1 has the strongest escalation, sharpest punchlines, and a seamless loop.

title: The Instant Reply Panic
insight: Replying in zero seconds makes you feel like a social monster.
caption: Leo replied to a text before it even hit the screen. Watch him try to act cool.

shots.scene: Leo sits in a bright room typing on his phone with worried eyes. Mia stands beside him holding a coffee mug with a smirk.

lines.text: I didn't reply fast, my phone glitched!
You replied in minus two seconds, Leo.

shots.scene: Leo is pacing the hallway looking nervous. Mia sits at the dining table typing on a laptop with a calm smirk.

lines.text: Okay but hear me out, I was typing!

shots.scene: Leo is pulling the pillow over his face on the couch. Mia stands nearby looking amused with raised eyebrows.

lines.text: Scoreboard fifty-eight. You look desperate.
I'm hiding under this pillow!

shots.scene: A notification arrives on a phone on the counter. Leo and Mia sit upright at the desk, looking startled.

lines.text: This is worse than your Sunday Scaries Trap.

shots.scene: A digital clock showing a time glows on the nightstand. Leo ducks under a blanket while Mia watches deadpan.

lines.text: Just one more minute! Next time: flat hunting!

shots.scene: Leo holds a blank phone facing forward. Mia holds a coffee mug, looking at him with raised eyebrows.

lines.text: Why are you staring at a blank screen?

title: Your Phone Dies Now
insight: Dying batteries turn a ten-step room into an extreme survival trek.
caption: When the phone hits one percent across the room. Good luck.

shots.scene: Leo staring at his phone screen in terror while typing on his phone. Mia sitting next to him on the couch with a coffee mug.

lines.text: It's at one percent! Move!
You're sitting five feet from the charger.

shots.scene: Leo walking pacing the hallway, shielding the phone screen like it's a fragile baby bird.

lines.text: Five feet is a marathon! The air is thin!
Gerald the plant looks healthier than you right now.

shots.scene: Leo dropping to his knees dramatically on the floor, holding the phone up to catch a signal.

lines.text: The screen just dimmed. It's saying goodbye.
Just plug it in, dude.

shots.scene: Leo diving forward in slow motion toward a wall outlet with the cord. In the background, clearly visible and drawn in the same style, stands a worried mom in a cardigan (the person being talked about), smaller than Leo and Mia and at the edge of the frame, never blocking their faces.

lines.text: I'm going in! Tell my mom I love her!

shots.scene: Leo plugging the phone in right as the screen goes black, then slumping against the wall.

lines.text: Told you so score is sixty now by the way.
Okay but hear me out.

shots.scene: Leo checking a notification message arrives on the screen, looking back up at Mia.

lines.text: What if it dies again?

title: The Pre-Sweat Protocol
insight: Your brain treats new jobs like bear attacks.
caption: When first-day nerves make you pre-sweat before entering the building. Next time: Leo faces the moving budget.

shots.scene: Leo pacing the hallway outside an office door in his yellow hoodie with worried eyes, facing camera.

lines.text: I can literally taste the fear right now!

shots.scene: Mia standing nearby holding a coffee mug, giving a deadpan raised eyebrow, facing camera.

lines.text: Your brain thinks a bear is chasing you.

shots.scene: Leo typing on his phone with wide hopeful eyes while standing upright, facing camera.

lines.text: So pre-sweating makes me taste bad to bears?

shots.scene: Mia standing near a digital clock showing a time on the hallway wall, smirking at camera.

lines.text: No, you are just leaking anxiety water, Leo.

shots.scene: Leo scrolling on his phone dramatically with a proud smirk, standing tall, facing camera.

lines.text: Okay but hear me out, it is survival!

shots.scene: Mia walking toward the door, turning back with tired eyes and closed lips, facing camera.

lines.text: Why are you throwing up in your mouth?

judge.why: Candidate 2 has the punchiest roasts with 'anxiety water' and loops seamlessly from throw-up back to tasting fear.

title: Your Fake Award
insight: Even a tiny fake win can make you feel like a genius.
caption: Leo turned Mia's prank into an absolute career victory. Part two incoming!

shots.scene: Leo typing on a laptop at the table while Mia drinks from a coffee mug, both facing forward with calm faces.

lines.text: Wait, did I actually finish that project?
You literally just sent it, Leo.

shots.scene: Leo staring nervously at his hands while Mia is texting on her phone with a subtle smirk.

lines.text: Then why do I feel like a fraud?
I made you a fake award!

shots.scene: Leo proudly holding a printed paper while Mia raises an eyebrow, as a notification arrives on her phone.

lines.text: World's Best Genius? I knew it!
Wait, it was a joke!

shots.scene: Leo holding Gerald the plant gently while Mia looks at her phone screen with raised eyebrows.

lines.text: Gerald the plant, I'm promoted!
Greg just emailed Noted.

shots.scene: Mia pacing the hallway holding her mug while Leo smiles quietly, facing the camera.

lines.text: Scoreboard sixty! Next time, part two!

shots.scene: Mia typing on a laptop next to Leo, looking over with curious eyes, both upright facing forward.

lines.text: Wait, what did you just submit?

title: The Soup Detective
insight: Feedback feels like an attack until you realize it helps.
caption: Leo treats honest feedback like a full crime investigation. Mia reminds him that growing means listening.

shots.scene: Leo is pacing the hallway while Mia sits upright drinking a cup of tea, watching him with raised eyebrows.

lines.text: Someone committed a crime against my soup today.
You mean my feedback that it needed salt?

shots.scene: Leo is typing on a laptop with worried eyes while Mia sits nearby with a tiny smirk.

lines.text: It was constructive critique, not a personal attack!
Then why are you wearing a plastic badge?

shots.scene: Leo is scrolling on his phone with a puzzled look while Mia smiles warmly at him.

lines.text: A detective must investigate every cruel rumor.
It's called growth, Leo. I want you to win.

shots.scene: A notification message arrives on Leo's phone while Mia leans forward with an amused expression.

lines.text: Wait, Greg just emailed back!
Did he give you five stars?

shots.scene: Leo holds a coffee mug with wide eyes while Mia smiles teasingly.

lines.text: He said 'Noted.' That means he loved it!
Scoreboard stands at sixty-two for my honest advice.

shots.scene: Leo is typing on his phone looking around with curious eyes while Mia shakes her head gently.

lines.text: Wait, who left that other review?
